_comment: Only what scripts/affected-tests.mjs cannot derive from imports, routes, API paths or i18n text. Keys are repo-relative path prefixes (or the special keys below); values are Playwright spec file names in apps/web/tests. Keep it small: if a rule can be derived, derive it.
_visual: A dialog screen in apps/web/tests/visual*.spec.ts, by screen name (the test title without the locale): the components its dialog renders. Everything they import comes with them; the page it opens on is read from the spec.
